class.name: NetwDatabaseBackend

method.name: _delete_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot] and resolves an [enum @GlobalScope.Error], which [method NetwDatabase.delete_slot] gives. Resolve an error when the slot could not be fully removed. [param session] is the [NetwMultiplayer] asking.

method.name: _list_slots
method.description: Resolves a [PackedStringArray] of every slot in storage, including ones written by earlier runs. [method NetwDatabase.list_slots] gives it. [param session] is the [NetwMultiplayer] asking.

method.name: _open
method.description: Resolves a new [NetwDatabaseConnection] for [param slot], or rejects with an error. [param session] is the [NetwMultiplayer] opening the slot.

method.name: delete_slot_default
method.description: The stock [method _delete_slot], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _delete_slot] calls this to reach it.

method.name: list_slots_default
method.description: The stock [method _list_slots], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _list_slots] calls this to reach it.

method.name: open_default
method.description: The stock [method _open], which rejects with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A subclass overriding [method _open] calls this to reach it.
